observed_features: Six storeys with red brick cladding
A long academic wing with repeated rectangular windows
White horizontal ledges along the long wing
Taller end masses with continuous vertical blue glazing
Flat roofs, light coping and a large E10 sign
limitations: Dimensions and hidden rear facade are approximate; the photo establishes appearance, not survey coordinates.
Floor-to-floor height 4.16 m is a modeling assumption consistent with two 13 x 0.16 m flights, not a measured building height.
Only the video-referenced third-floor corridor and existing stair flights are traversable interior reconstruction.
Other floors are exterior shell geometry; no interior rooms, full inter-floor stairs or operating lifts are claimed.
The adjacent blue-glass E9 building, cars, street and street furniture are not copied.
Only the four user-supplied dimensions are measurement constraints; the 0.16 m riser is approximate.
38.4 m length is an editable visual-layout estimate, not a surveyed or recovered video-odometry measurement.
13 risers are a visual count estimate; 0.28 m tread and terminal landings are inferred.
Far stairs and downward-flight completion reuse estimated start-flight dimensions; hidden geometry is not observed.
Only the filmed corridor level and stair terminal landings are modeled, not full upper/lower floors or rooms behind doors.
Room-door count, spacing, signs and elevator dimensions are approximate; no unverified room names are reproduced.
Closed doors and elevator are static; no robot policy or door/elevator animation is included.
